description: A React component for a donation form with payment integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Patreon), managing donation state, rendering payment buttons, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: DonateForm
classes.description: A React component class for rendering and managing a donation form with multiple payment options, state management, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Resets donation state when the component is unmounted.

methods.name: onDonationStateChange
methods.description: Updates donation form state when donation details change.

methods.name: handlePaymentButtonLoad
methods.description: Updates loading state for payment provider buttons.

methods.name: postPayment
methods.description: Handles post-payment actions, including calling postCharge with payment data.

methods.name: resetDonation
methods.description: Resets donation form state to default.

methods.name: renderButtonGroup
methods.description: Renders payment method buttons and related UI elements.

methods.name: renderPageForm
methods.description: Renders the full donation page form.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method, displays success/error or donation form UI.
